title: کلید گمشده
introduction: در این داستان کوتاه، واژه‌های مربوط به خانه و مکان‌ها را در جمله می‌بینی.
paragraphs: Tom cannot find his key. He looks on the table, under the chair, and next to the door. The key is not there.
He asks his sister, “Have you seen my key?” She says, “Maybe it is in your bag.”
Tom opens his bag. There is a small notebook, two pens, and his key!
“I found it!” he says with a smile. His sister laughs. “Next time, check your bag first!”
